Package iu.client.jsonb

package iu.client.jsonb
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    iu.client
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ContinuationReader
    Reads the rest of an object from the text it was parsed from, as a JSON object of its own: an opening brace, then the text from where the rest begins.
    IuDeserializationContext
    One deserialization call: the options snapshot and property path from IuJsonbContext, plus the JsonbDeserializer invocations in progress for re-entry checks.
    IuJsonb
    Implements Jsonb over the IuJsonAdapter conversions, streaming through IuJsonAdapter.read(JsonParser) and IuJsonAdapter.write(Object, JsonGenerator).
    IuJsonb.AdapterReference
    A configured JsonbAdapter and the types it converts between.
    IuJsonbAdapter<T>
    Converts a business object type using its IuJsonbModel, as part of the call in progress: its options snapshot names the properties, its path locates a failure, and its cycle check rejects a recursive reference.
    IuJsonbBinaryAdapter
    Converts byte[] by the binary data strategy of the call in progress: JsonbConfig.BINARY_DATA_STRATEGY, or the IuJsonSerializationOptions.getBinaryDataStrategy() of a IuJsonAdapter.SERIALIZATION_OPTIONS snapshot; always BinaryDataStrategy.BASE_64_URL with JsonbConfig.STRICT_IJSON.
    IuJsonbBoundedParser
    The view of a parser a JsonbDeserializer reads through, limited to the value it deserializes.
    IuJsonbBuilder
    Builds IuJsonb instances; uses IuJson.PROVIDER unless another JSON-P provider is supplied.
    IuJsonbContext
    State shared by one serialization or deserialization call: a single options snapshot, and the property path to the value being converted.
    IuJsonbEnumAdapter<E extends Enum<E>>
    Converts an enum type as text, or as an object when IuJsonSerializationOptions.isEnumAsObject().
    IuJsonbGenerator
    Builds the JsonValue described by JsonGenerator calls, so a JsonbSerializer can run in a tree conversion.
    IuJsonbModel
    The properties of a business object type, as the provider converts them: a BeanModel discovered with the provider's visibility and order strategies, and each property's configured conversions.
    IuJsonbModel.Creator
    Creates a business object from values read from JSON, with its parameters' configured conversions.
    IuJsonbModel.Property
    One property, with its configured conversions.
    IuJsonbNaming
    How a call names properties in JSON: by an IU property name format, which a IuJsonAdapter.SERIALIZATION_OPTIONS supplier may change from call to call, or by a JSON-B PropertyNamingStrategy fixed for the provider.
    IuJsonbObjectAdapter
    Built-in conversion for Object and other broad declared types.
    IuJsonbParser
    Reports a JsonValue as JsonParser events, so a JsonbDeserializer can run in a tree conversion.
    IuJsonbProvider
    Provides IuJsonb through JsonbProvider service lookup.
    IuJsonbValueAdapter<T>
    Converts one Java type according to IuJsonb configuration.
    IuSerializationContext
    One serialization call: the options snapshot and property path from IuJsonbContext, plus the values in progress for re-entry and cycle checks.
    JsonbMetadata
    Reads JSON-B annotations; the only class the IU binding paths reach that refers to the JSON-B API, loaded only when the API is present.
